title: Portronics Clamp Z Car Phone Holder Stand with 360 Degree Rotation, AC Vent Mount, Strong Grip, Single Hand Use, Shockproof Build, Mobile Stand for Car (Black)
bullets: Secure AC Vent Mount: Easily attaches to your car’s air vent, keeping your phone stable and within easy reach. The design of Portronics Clamp Z car phone holder ensures that your phone remains secure even on bumpy roads.

Strong & Steady Grip: The grip of this car mobile holder provides a firm and stable hold, preventing your phone from slipping or swaying, ensuring that your device stays in place throughout your journey.

Effortless One-Hand Operation: Easily operate your phone with one hand, ensuring safety and convenience while driving. The simple design of this car phone stand allows quick mounting and removal of your phone.
Durable Shockproof ABS Build: Constructed with high-quality ABS material, the car mobile stand absorbs impacts to protect your phone from damage, ensuring longevity and durability for everyday use.
180° Adjustable Rotation: Rotate freely to find the perfect viewing angle for navigation and calls. This enhances your driving convenience and safety by providing optimal visibility.
Universal Compatibility: Perfectly fits smartphones from 5.4" to 6.7", providing a secure fit for various devices, ensuring you can use your favorite phone safely and conveniently in your car.
